author: Ifmyante
text:
I'd like to put one more piece of chitchat in here.

We all know that I want to move on from RTM, and that in making it
subscription based, I had hoped to be able to fund an international
movement which will destroy the empire which rules us, and begin the new
 era of enlightenment we've evolved to create.

It saddens me greatly to find that so many of our members are here
simply to cheaply steal our material and sell it on at great profit.

I have lots more lessons to share, and would love to do so, to further help those of you who came with a good heart.

But how can I deliver them, knowing they'll be stolen the moment they're published?

It seems RTM membership doesn't even make up 0.5% of those paying to study RTM material.

I'm feeling quite betrayed right now

text:

text:
